import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        // Only one test case as in original code
        solve(sc);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long a = 0, b = 0;
        double bestVal = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY; // equivalent to 1ll<<60 in init

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long mod = (i * x) % y;
            long minDist = Math.min(mod, y - mod);
            double curVal = (double) minDist / i;

            if (curVal < bestVal) {
                bestVal = curVal;
                b = i;
                if (mod <= y - mod) {
                    a = (i * x) / y; // floor
                } else {
                    a = (i * x) / y + 1; // ceil
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
    }
}
